text:
sam (support): FYI — multiple customers reporting 502/504 on /v1/generate since ~17:05 UTC, p95 latency spiking. Tickets piling, CC'ing oncall.

amar (oncall): on it. Can someone paste the customer request sample and logs?

sam (support): customer attached curl repro: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rwd-xxl","input":"short prompt"}'``` they see 502 after ~3s.

ops-bot: alert: host/gateway-prod-4 error_rate > 5% (5m) — 502/504 surge.

liz (prod-eng): hitting similar in metrics. 502s concentrated on eu-west ingress pool 3, connection resets upstream. No obvious deploy at 17:00.

mike (sre): can we check auth-proxy and nginx timestamps? adding logging here: `kubectl logs -n gateway ingress-gw-3 -c proxy | tail -n 100`

amar (oncall): I grabbed logs, seeing a repeated upstream timeout: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`, and a few `502: broken pipe` traces. KV-cache eviction spikes at same time.

sam (support): customers reporting impact on short requests (few tokens). One mentions retries exponential backoff not preventing duplicate charges — red flag for billing folks.

liz (prod-eng): hypothesis: recent autoscaler change lowered max conns per pod, causing TCP handoffs under burst. Rolling back autoscaler patch to previous rev (r22) now.

amar (oncall): rolling back now. Mirroring to eu-west-3 first. Will post progress. :eyes: 

ops-bot: deploy rollback started for gateway-autoscaler (rev r21) — job id 7f9c.

mike (sre): while rollback running, enabling circuit-breaker fallback route to dedicated-fallback model pool for requests that hit timeout so customers get 200 with degraded performance rather than 502. Applying change to routing rules.

sam (support): communicating to affected customers: short note drafted, will send when we confirm rollback impact.

liz (prod-eng): rollback finished on eu-west-3, error rate down from 7.2% to 1.1% in 3m. Pushing same to global pools.

amar (oncall): global rollback completed. Monitoring p50/p95 — p95 dropping, 502 count trending down.

ops-bot: alert resolved: host/gateway-prod-4 error_rate back to baseline.

mike (sre): followups: 1) revert autoscaler config that reduced max-conns-per-pod; 2) add synthetic short-req load test to CI (eu-west) for autoscaler PRs; 3) improve KV-cache warmup to avoid eviction spikes during scale events; 4) add explicit billing-safe retry guidance for SDKs. Assigning owners below.

sam (support): please add communication to billing team re: potential duplicate charges and recommend grace window for retries.

liz (prod-eng): taking action 1+3. I'll open RFC and link the autoscaler PR that caused this.

mike (sre): taking action 2. Will add the CI job and a runbook step for fast rollback.

amar (oncall): I'll own on-call runbook updates and make a short postmortem with timeline and RCA.

sam (support): I'm sending customer update now: short apology, mitigation summary, ETA for followup.

liz (prod-eng): quick repro notes copied into incident tracker: request sample, proxy logs snippet, autoscaler delta, KV-cache metric graphs.

mike (sre): postmortem action list: - autoscaler revert + test, - routing fallback as safety net (validate), - SDK retry doc update, - billing comps checklist. Will sync with finance for refunds.

sam (support): thanks everyone — tickets updated and notify list sent. closing warroom for now, will follow up with formal postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
